svg.text: Keyword-family matrix (maintainers): every language against every family
2,936 cells have a rule: 217 measured against a parser, 1,801 decoy test only, 918 not tested; 2,320 cells are N/A. Hover a cell for numbers. The README figure is the summary of this.
decoy test only (SOP-001 first-pass, SOP-002 spec-grade): grey
Decoy tiers: grey now (SOP-001, SOP-002). Stricter tiers (SOP-003 and later) take more colour until a test is as thorough as a parser.
Parser cells: colour = the lower of recall and precision. Faded: under 10 functions. Hatched: corpus not pinned (exploratory).
